title: Polymarket New Markets
description: Tracks newly created markets on Polymarket, sorted by creation date. Get early signals on what topics are emerging. Useful for early-mover advantage - markets often have the most mispricing when first created before liquidity deepens.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = 'https://gamma-api.polymarket.com'

resp = requests.get(
    f'{BASE}/markets',
    params={'limit': 100, 'offset': 0, 'active': 'true', 'closed': 'false', 'order': 'createdAt', 'ascending': 'false'},
    timeout=30,
)
resp.raise_for_status()
markets = resp.json()

rows = []
for m in markets:
    prices = m.get('outcomePrices', '[]')
    if isinstance(prices, str):
        prices = json.loads(prices)
    yes_price = float(prices[0]) if prices else None
    no_price = float(prices[1]) if len(prices) > 1 else None
    tags_raw = m.get('tags', [])
    if isinstance(tags_raw, str):
        tags_raw = json.loads(tags_raw)
    tag_labels = []
    for t in (tags_raw or []):
        if isinstance(t, dict):
            tag_labels.append(t.get('label', t.get('slug', '')))
        else:
            tag_labels.append(str(t))
    created = m.get('createdAt', '')
    rows.append({
        'market_id': m.get('id', ''),
        'question': m.get('question', ''),
        'slug': m.get('slug', ''),
        'yes_price': yes_price,
        'no_price': no_price,
        'volume': float(m.get('volume', 0) or 0),
        'liquidity': float(m.get('liquidity', 0) or 0),
        'category': m.get('category', ''),
        'tags': ','.join(tag_labels),
        'created_at': created,
        'accepting_orders': m.get('acceptingOrders', False),
        'condition_id': m.get('conditionId', ''),
        '_epoch': int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp()),
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
